summary_en: National framework for short-term skill training, recognition of prior learning and certification through empanelled training providers.
eligibility_en: Varies by course and training partner; many courses are open to school leavers and school students. Check the individual course listing.
benefit_en: Access to short-term certified skill courses and, for some courses, fee support as notified by the scheme.
source_org: Skill India / Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

summary_en: Apprenticeship training positions in industry under the Apprentices Act framework, listed and matched through the national apprenticeship portal.
eligibility_en: Eligibility depends on the apprenticeship trade and the employer's requirements; minimum age and qualification rules apply.
benefit_en: Structured on-the-job training with a stipend, which the scheme may partially support for participating employers.
source_org: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship / Directorate General of Training

summary_en: The National Skills Qualifications Framework organises qualifications into levels so that skills acquired in different ways can be recognised and compared.
eligibility_en: Not a scheme — a framework. Individual qualifications set their own entry requirements.
benefit_en: Helps students understand how a vocational qualification compares with other qualifications and how to progress to higher levels.
source_org: National Council for Vocational Education and Training

name_en: ITI trade training and National Trade Certificates
summary_en: Industrial Training Institutes offer trade courses leading to National Trade Certificates, which are recognised for many technical jobs and apprenticeships.
eligibility_en: Usually Class 8 or Class 10 pass depending on the trade. Admission rules are set by the state and the institute.
benefit_en: Trade qualification that supports employment in industry and further technical education routes.

summary_en: Vocational subjects are offered in many schools from the secondary stage, letting students sample trades before choosing a full pathway.
eligibility_en: Offered through participating schools; availability varies by school and state.
benefit_en: Early exposure to vocational subjects with certification, which can be continued after school.

summary_en: State-level corporations run placement-linked skill training, sometimes with travel, boarding or fee support for eligible candidates.
eligibility_en: Set by each state corporation and the specific batch being recruited. Verify with the state portal or district skill office.
benefit_en: Training support and often placement linkage for candidates who meet the batch criteria.
source_org: State Skill Development Corporations (verify with your state portal)
